answer: Each agent posts a 40-unit deposit and its referral links are public, so a whisper of a new identity is checked first. A fake cluster echoes one referrer, and the spiral collapses under one inspection. Any peer may dispute a suspect; if the jury agrees, its deposit is slashed and the referrer loses half its stake. Forging 100 identities costs 4000 units for a 900-unit pool, so it loses money. Honest agents pay once and keep their full reward.
